 Job Description
 We are seeking a skilled Network Security Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in securing and maintaining our network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with one or more major security vendors such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, or Cisco within a globally distributed enterprise network.
 Key Responsibilities:
Managing and maintaining network security solutions using Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, or Cisco technologies. 
Microsoft Azure:
AZ-104, AZ-700 – desirable but not mandatory
Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot firewalls, VPNs, IPS, and other security appliances. 
Monitor network security, analyze threats, and respond to security incidents in a timely manner. 
Develop and enforce security policies, procedures, and best practices. 
Perform security risk assessments and recommend solutions to mitigate vulnerabilities. 
Configure and troubleshoot network routing protocols as part of security design and optimization. 
Conduct network troubleshooting, including packet capture and deep analysis using Wireshark and other network diagnostic tools. 
Collaborate with IT teams to ensure seamless integration of security solutions with network infrastructure. 
Stay up to date with emerging cybersecurity threats and industry best practices. 
 Qualifications
 Required Skills & Experience:
Mandatory:
Hands-on experience with one or more of the following:
Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, or Cisco security solutions within a globally distributed enterprise network. 
Strong understanding of firewall policies, VPNs, IDS/IPS and network segmentation. 
Microsoft Azure experience
Hands-on experience with network troubleshooting, packet capture, and deep packet analysis using Wireshark. 
Experience with network protocols, routing, switching, and awareness of security frameworks. 
Experience with security monitoring tools, SIEM, and incident response procedures. 
Relevant certifications from vendors such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, or Cisco is highly desirable. 
Excellent spoken and written English skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications:
Exposure to cloud security (Azure prefered) and hybrid environments. 
Familiarity with automation and orchestration tools for security operations. 
Knowledge of scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell) is a plus. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
